name: Línghuàn Dàoshì
summary:
Elf Wor is an unlicensed Sega Mega Drive game developed by Gamtec. Its true identity is unknown - whereas the ROM header lists the game's name as "Elf Wor", the title screen calls it 靈幻道士 (Spiritual Magic Priest), and Super Magician. It has also been referred to as Reigen Doushi and Revenge of Fu Manchu.

The game is strikingly similar to Zombies Ate My Neighbors, though has a more eastern setting.

name: Língwén Xīyóu
summary: A rogue-lite TCG based on classical Chinese mythology.

name: Língua
summary: Follow Beto's adventure through the northeast of Brazil in this top-down adventure! Solve puzzles, battle to free animal spirits and finish quests to help a friend retrieve a valuable possession!

name: Língjiè Yì Wén Lù
summary: "Língjiè Yì Wén Lù" is a Japanese-style story background, combined with a fresh and beautiful art style, and supplemented by a variety of special systems, showing players a wonderful Japanese magical two-dimensional world.
